result.brief: SGF+ 将自回归视频生成中"写入 KV 上下文"与"去噪当前帧"两个角色解耦为独立参数，通过因果注意力保持交互，无需辅助损失即可提升视觉质量与长时序一致性，并支持 24 小时连续外推生成。
result.reason: Proposes role-specific parameterization decoupling context writing from denoising in autoregressive video generation, improving long-horizon consistency; directly a video generation method contribution.
